citation.authors: Pattanittum P, Ngamjarus C, Buttramee F, Somboonporn C

cited_by.title: Hibiscus (sorrel, zobo, bissap) and blood pressure

record.population: Adults with high blood pressure; strict Cochrane criteria
record.design: Cochrane review of randomised trials of roselle against placebo or no treatment, searched to August 2021
record.finding: Only one trial met the criteria (60 people with type 2 diabetes, 8 weeks, capsules). Effect on systolic pressure was 1.65 mmHg (95% CI -7.89 to 11.19), very low certainty. The review concludes evidence is insufficient to say whether roselle lowers blood pressure.
record.note: Counter-evidence. Cochrane's inclusion rules were narrower than the 2025 umbrella review, which is why they disagree.
